body:
Now (checked on main 30 Oct): miss the 21:00 bus home from the beach → you camp at the beach until the next bus. The bus runs 3 days a week, so a kid can be stuck 3-4 game days (about 45-60 real minutes).
Option A: keep it as it is.
Option B: a small morning bus home every day (suggested by night 2's reviewer, 9 Oct).
Never decided.
short: Decided: a morning bus home from the beach daily
source: chat 2026-10-30: board row from Bugs and fixes (night 2 report, 9 Oct)
title: Missed the 21:00 beach bus: camp until the next bus, or a daily morning bus home?
